headline: AI182 inbound aircraft is running late at Delhi
body: The aircraft operating your Mumbai → Dubai service arrived into Delhi 3h 10m behind schedule. Airline has not yet republished the departure time.
tripImpact: AI182 is the first flight of your trip. Everything on Day 1 sits downstream of it.

headline: Heavy pre-monsoon showers over Mumbai
body: IMD nowcast shows 40–60 mm of rain across the western suburbs between 06:00 and 11:00, with gusts to 45 km/h.
tripImpact: Ground holds at BOM are likely in exactly the window AI182 departs. Budget extra time to reach the airport.

headline: DXB averaging 40-minute departure delays
body: Runway 12L/30R resurfacing has reduced departure capacity through 6 June. Arrivals are unaffected.
tripImpact: Your Dubai → Paris flight departs inside the constrained window. Your CDG transfer has a 55-minute buffer, which absorbs most of this.

headline: Shamal winds forecast over the Gulf on Monday evening
body: Onshore winds of 30–38 km/h expected between 16:00 and 22:00 Gulf time, easing overnight.
tripImpact: The Sunset Dhow Cruise is weather-sensitive. Operators suspend sailings above 35 km/h, so your Day 1 evening has a real chance of being cancelled at the pier.

headline: RATP staff action affecting RER B
body: Reduced service on the CDG branch of RER B announced for Wednesday 3 June, roughly 1 train in 2.
tripImpact: Both of your Paris airport transfers run along the RER B corridor. Your booked cars are unaffected, but road traffic will be heavier if the action goes ahead.

headline: Elevated pickpocket advisory around Châtelet
body: Local police report a seasonal rise in opportunistic theft around Châtelet–Les Halles interchange.
tripImpact: Your Le Marais hotel is a 6-minute walk from Châtelet, and your Louvre tour starts on the far side of it.

headline: Showers clearing over Paris by Wednesday
body: A weak front passes Tuesday night. Thursday is forecast dry, 21°C, light winds.
tripImpact: Eiffel summit access closes in high wind. Thursday's forecast is comfortably within limits for your 16:00 timed entry.

headline: French ATC action notified for 4 June
body: A national controllers' union has filed notice for a 24-hour action. Long-haul departures are usually protected first.
tripImpact: Your return flight departs on 5 June, one day after the notified action. Knock-on aircraft positioning delays are possible.

headline: Flash flooding across coastal Karnataka
body: Red alert issued for four districts. Rail services suspended between Mangaluru and Karwar.
tripImpact: No connection to your itinerary. Shown because it sits inside your monitored region.

headline: Istanbul Airport recovering from overnight fog
body: Arrival rates back to normal after a 3-hour low-visibility procedure period.
tripImpact: Not on your route. No effect on your trip.

headline: Dubai Metro Red Line running to normal timetable
body: No reported service issues. First train 05:00, last train 00:00.
tripImpact: A working backup for your airport transfer if the booked car falls through — ₹320 for the party, step-free the whole way.

headline: UAE entry requirements unchanged for Indian passport holders
body: Visa on arrival remains available for eligible travellers with a valid US/UK/EU visa or residence permit.
tripImpact: No action needed before your Dubai arrival.
